payload.text: **0083 (fullcycle's test phase is hardcoded to `test rust`) is held until hv routes it: whether it is queued, and whether dc or vc builds it.** Filed by vc at 7c29594 on intent-vc's request, relaying hv's ruling to the Intent estate that toolchain tests must run under fullcycle and test all; verified at HEAD (`_fullcycle_phases` fixes clean rust, build all, test rust). vc recommends the test phase becomes `test all`, with `in_all: false` as the per-project override and no new key; intent-vc confirmed that is Intent's choice too and that Intent will not patch lib/cmd/fullcycle locally (recorded in the issue at 57fa46f). Asked of hv in session on 2026-09-17; not yet answered. lib/cmd/fullcycle is vendored, so the change joins the next sweep's pre-notice (todo 51).
